fields.statement: At 6af6a212a: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/workflow/... ok (TestBuiltinVerifierTierDefaults parses the built-in build and review workflows and asserts models [opus], low_risk_models [sonnet] and the twelve risky_paths globs on both verifier roles); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(workflow-describe|describe-golden)$' ok; a scratch build's `rhiza workflow describe build` and `describe review` both print role verifier models [opus], low_risk_models [sonnet] and risky_paths [*_test.go, **/*_test.go, **/testdata/**, **/main_test.go, .githooks/**, **/hooks/**, .github/**, .rhiza/workflows/**, internal/workflow/builtin/**, **/migrations/**, **/migrate/**, **/*retry*]. The diff only touches build.toml, review.toml, the test and the testscript; it adds no rhiza.* setting. make self-check in a clean detached checkout with env -i fails only on rendered-file staleness (actor/claude-code-57cdad9f.md missing, index.md differs). The identical failure is present at parent dee8a4784 (the run's evidence commit), so it is run-machinery render drift that `rhiza render` at ship will fix. Every other self-check step passes.
